text:
Lena M: Heads-up: a hiring manager pinged that several interviewers show as "not certified" in the scheduler even though they completed the new interviewer training yesterday.
Devon R: Which cohort/team?
Lena M: Customer success interviews — about 9 folks who finished the LMS course.
Ivy C: I just checked LMS — completions recorded and certificates issued. Any error in the sync job?
lms-sync-bot: [07:12] LMS->HRIS sync job failed: 502 Bad Gateway from /api/greenhouse/bulk-update
Marco P: Looks like our downstream HRIS/ATS endpoint rate-limited during the bulk patch.
Devon R: If the ATS didn't get the "certified" flag, our scheduling pipeline filters them out from auto-invite pools.
Ivy C: Can we re-run the sync for the completed course roster? I can export a CSV with learner_id, email, completion_ts.
Lena M: Please do. Interviews start tomorrow so we need invites going today.
Marco P: Short term: I'll retry the sync in smaller batches and add exponential backoff to avoid the 502. Also queue a targeted backfill for the last 24h completions.
Devon R: Do we have an idempotency key so we don't double-apply certs?
Marco P: Yes — we use completion_id as idempotency token. The earlier failure left the job half-applied so we need to verify which rows succeeded.
lms-sync-bot: [07:20] Partial success: 6 rows applied, 3 failed due to upstream 502
Ivy C: I'll share the CSV of the 9 completions to the backfill job. One of them has an alternate email (work vs personal) so mapping might be the issue.
Lena M: Good point — recruiters sometimes update emails in ATS; matching should prefer ATS email if present.
Marco P: I'll add a pre-sync reconciliation step: match by ATS user_id if present, otherwise fallback to email. Also log mismatches to #people-ops.
Devon R: Timeline for deploy and backfill?
Marco P: 45 min to push the batching + reconciliation change, run the targeted backfill, and confirm flags in ATS.
Ivy C: Exported CSV uploaded to the backfill job: `backfill-lms-2145678901.csv`.
lms-sync-bot: [07:55] backfill job backfill-lms-2145678901 started
lms-sync-bot: [08:12] backfill-lms-2145678901 finished: 9 rows applied, 0 failures
Devon R: Confirmed — the 9 interviewers now show as certified in the scheduler.
Lena M: Recruiters notified, invites requeued. One caveat: two interviewers already had manual calendar declines earlier; I'll coordinate with recruiters to re-offer slots.
Ivy C: I'll add a note in the Training Ops runbook to include ATS user_id in the export and to prefer stable identifiers.
Marco P: I'll add metrics to the sync job: success rate, upstream 5xx counts, and average batch size. Also unit tests for fallback matching logic.
Devon R: Can we add an alert if >2% of completions fail to apply in a 1h window?
Marco P: Yes, adding a Slack alert to #people-ops and a Datadog monitor.
Lena M: Thanks all — big relief. Please add the small postmortem to the Recruiting Ops folder with steps to prevent recurrence.
Ivy C: Will do. Also adding a note to ask recruiters to avoid personal emails in learner exports.
Lena M: Closing loop — excellent turnaround :thumbsup:
